'''Capital City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kari]] homeworld [[Karideph]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and, like the rest of [[Karideph]], was heavily populated. The major industry driving the Karideph economy was food production.
